title: The Montgomery–Dyson Coincidence as a Q6 Prime Lattice Eigenvalue Identity
desc: In 1972, Montgomery and Dyson independently observed that the pair correlation of Riemann zeta zeros matches the GUE eigenvalue statistics of heavy atomic nuclei — a coincidence unexplained for 54 years. We propose both distributions arise as special cases of the Q6 prime lattice operator L_{Q6} on l^2(N), defined by coupling kernel M(i,j) = 1/gcd(i,j). Riemann zeros are identified with the full infinite-dimensional spectrum of L_{Q6}; nuclear energy levels correspond to finite shell truncations
